title: knowledge_parts.json
description: Typed, linked parts extracted from a document. Every text passage, table, and image becomes a discrete source_part with a title, extraction path, and provenance metadata. Matches the knowledge_sources + knowledge_source_parts DB schema and API types.

source.description: The document this extraction came from — maps to the knowledge_sources table. API type: KnowledgeSource.

id.description: UUID for this source. Auto-generated by the API if omitted on create.

reference_id.description: Optional human-readable identifier for external system mapping (e.g., 'doc-001'). Must be unique within the workflow.

workflow_id.description: FK to the workflow this source belongs to

metadata.description: Extraction-level metadata. Stored as JSON string in DB, parsed as object in API responses.

total_chunks.description: Number of chunks/sections processed (Docling chunks or ODL heading-derived sections)

tag_source.description: Provenance of structural tags: ODL consumed the tagged-PDF tree (structure_tree), fell back to XY-Cut++ layout (xycut_fallback), or came via Docling HybridChunker (docling)

parts.description: Flat list of source_parts ordered by document position. Maps to knowledge_source_parts table. API field name is 'part' (singular) on KnowledgeSource responses.

id.description: Part ID. Use document-prefixed IDs for multi-doc projects (e.g., 'doc-1-chapter-3') or sequential IDs (e.g., 'p-001'). Auto-generated UUID by API if omitted on create.

reference_id.description: Optional human-readable identifier. Must be unique within the source.

source_id.description: FK to the parent source. Present in the local file but stripped before upload — the API sets it automatically from the URL path.

type.description: Part type. Serialized as 'type' in JSON (Rust field is part_type with serde rename).

content.description: Text content. For tables: markdown rendering. For images: base64 data URI.

content_metadata.description: Type-specific metadata. Stored as JSON string in DB, parsed as object in API responses. For tables: num_rows, num_cols, headers, rows. For images: mimetype, width, height. For text: omit or null.

rows.description: 2D array of cell texts excluding header row (type=table only)

caption.description: Caption text associated with a table or image

caption_part_id.description: Part ID of the caption text part

caption_for_part_id.description: Part ID of the table/image this text captions (on caption text parts)

title.description: Leaf heading (last element of extraction_path). Optional in API (nullable).

extraction_path.description: Full heading hierarchy from root to leaf, as a JSON-encoded array string (e.g., '["3 Model Architecture", "3.2 Attention"]'). Stored as TEXT in DB. Optional in API (nullable).

extraction_metadata.description: Provenance metadata from the extraction process. Stored as JSON string in DB, parsed as object in API responses.

source_chunks.description: Docling chunk indices where this part's doc_item appeared

doc_item.description: JSON pointer back to the DoclingDocument item

related.description: Part IDs of co-occurring items (from the same Docling chunk)

semantic_type.description: ODL-derived semantic type of the source element. Present when backend=odl.

heading_level.description: Heading depth (1..6) when this part is a heading or was grouped under one. Present when backend=odl and structure tree was consumed.

parent_section.description: Text of the nearest ancestor heading (breadcrumb). Present when backend=odl and a heading ancestor exists.

tag_source.description: Per-part provenance of structural tags. Mirrors source.metadata.tag_source — duplicated here so individual parts remain self-describing.
